categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the Validation label and alters assumeutxo snapshot loading validation to reject malformed snapshot files.
categories.rationale: Tightens assumeutxo snapshot parsing by rejecting duplicate coin records and empty transaction groups. Snapshot loading currently accepts duplicate records that inflate `coins_loaded` and empty groups that bypass shutdown checks; addressing this hardens snapshot validation against malformed inputs without affecting valid snapshots generated by `dumptxoutset`.
